summary: Independent Q6 inspection of continuityctl, lab start, and the ContinuityEngine mixin MRO at 8b06eec0 finds a genuine regional JetStream continuity control plane: SQLite durability, origin generations, publish attempts, hub archive sync, consumer effects/checkpoints, fencing, replay, retention, and live nats-server domains. Honest reachable runtime/config LOC is about 4,703 after discounting generated seed SQL, MRO-shadowed policy method copies, unused store helpers, and a dead CLI entry; that clears the large_system_strict 3,000 floor. Leaf mixins are thinner and often wrong relative to policy.py, which is starter-defect overlay rather than a toy system. PADDING_RISK is MEDIUM from those unreachable duplicates, not HIGH.

evidence.observation: Q6 independently judges whether the solver-visible core is complex, reachable, coupled, non-toy, and non-padded. For large_system_strict, >=3000 substantive reachable runtime/config LOC is necessary but not sufficient. Complexity Governor and authenticity-validator outcomes were not copied.

Required method: trace entrypoints, module reachability, distinct responsibilities, clone/wrapper/filler risk, cross-module invariants, a ~25% removal test, and data/state consumption versus logic. large_system_strict PASS also forbids HIGH toy or padding risk.

Count only implementation that materially participates in the claimed operational system. Dead/unreachable/duplicate code and seed volume are not authored runtime complexity. 3,000 LOC is a floor with no upper target.
Software/Systems Python/bash/SQL JetStream continuity task; artifacts [/app/continuity]; separate verifier; workdir /app/continuity; public network; agent timeout 10800.
Design record binds profile=large_system_strict only. Defect lists and creator claims were not treated as Q6 conclusions.

Pinned debian bookworm-slim installs python3, sqlite3, tmux, asciinema, and digest-checksummed nats-server 2.14.3; copies /app/continuity, bakes nats-py 2.15.0, and seeds continuity.db at image build. Real operator runtime packaging, not a stub.
Primary operator entrypoint execs python -m continuity.cli with CONTINUITY_ROOT=/app/continuity.

Operator surface reaches db-init, inspect, reconcile, observe-origin, publish, plan/execute-replay, lease, retention, lab-start/stop, archive-sync, run-consumer, reset, and verify. make_engine instantiates engine.ContinuityEngine, not policy.ContinuityEngine. main() is the process entry; async_main is unreferenced.

ContinuityEngine MRO is PublishMixin, GenerationMixin, ConsumerMixin, ReconcileMixin, ReplayMixin, FencingMixin, RetentionMixin, then policy.ContinuityEngine. Leaf mixins therefore win overlapping method names at runtime.

Base engine still supplies live config/topology, expected_stream_for_event, validate_event_generation, effect payload helpers, reconcile_all, renew_recovery_lease, execute_replay_plan, apply_retention, and inspect_health. Overlapping publish/generation/consumer/reconcile/replay/lease/retention methods are MRO-dead copies (~405 lines).

Live publish_event records an attempt, marks the journal PUBLISHED before the origin ACK, then publishes with an attempt-suffixed Nats-Msg-Id. Branched timeout/error/ack paths; reduced predicates are starter defects on a real publish state machine, not a constant-output shell.

Live origin observation validates configured stream/domain, auto-approves first and fingerprint-change generations, and updates high-water on matching fingerprints including sequence regression. Distinct generation responsibility reachable from observe-origin.

Live process_delivery advances ACK/checkpoint before effect commit, inserts effect_dispatches, and treats quarantine as an acked path. consumer_health always returns True. Called from ConsumerRunner.process_until_idle.

Live reconcile_region compares journal/archive counts and hub aggregate sequence, persists findings, and infers missing ids from origin_sequence > archive_count. Reached from continuityctl reconcile/verify via reconcile_all.

Live plan_replay builds a full journal min/max range from missing_event_ids and blocks only exact-equal active ranges. execute_replay_plan remains on the live policy class and publishes under a recovery lease.

Live acquire_recovery_lease reuses the prior epoch on expired reacquire; assert_recovery_fence checks owner and expiry but not fence_epoch. renew_recovery_lease stays on the live policy class and calls LeaseToken.assert_current.

Live compute_retention_decision writes archive/consumer/replay watermarks then sets cleanup_safe_sequence to archive_sequence only. apply_retention remains live on policy and deletes eligible journal rows.

SQLite persistence with WAL, immediate transactions, journal/publish attempts, generations, archive upsert, effects/checkpoints, replay plans/items, leases, and retention watermarks. Eighteen helpers have no package callers (~156 lines); the remainder is operator-reachable.

Live NATS connection pool, JetStream STREAM/CONSUMER API upsert/info/msg-get, NatsPublisher with expected-stream ACK check, RuntimeBootstrap for east/west/hub streams, ArchiveSynchronizer, ConsumerRunner pull-fetch, and LabProcessManager pid/monitor lifecycle for three nats-server domains.

Domain types with validation: EventIdentity event_id regex vs region/generation/sequence, envelopes, topology/sources, leases with expiry/assert_current, replay range overlap, retention horizon, health report aggregation. Not lookup-table padding.

Native schema (~262 substantive lines) for regions, generations, devices, journal, publish_attempts, archive_index, consumers, effects, checkpoints, reconciliation, replay, leases, retention. Counts as runtime structure.

Deterministic seed builds 240 devices and 12,000 journal rows across east/west with varied types/priorities/publish states, archive holes (west 5311/5489/5603, east 5397/5521), lagged required-consumer effects, and approved replay plan rp-west-incident-001. Evidence of stateful scale only; 239 generative lines excluded from runtime/config LOC.

Runtime config binds east/west/hub URLs, duplicate stream_name EDGE_TELEMETRY, hub subjects telemetry.raw.>, source domain/subject mappings, and stream max-age. Loaded by ContinuityEngine.from_json_file and RuntimeBootstrap.
Three JetStream domain configs (hub/east/west) with ports, store_dir, leafnode mesh, and resource limits. LabProcessManager starts nats-server against these files.

Incident handoff asserts west disconnect, archive identity gaps, ack-vs-effect disagreement, duplicate index effect, and unsafe cleanup vs approved replay. Matches seed holes and controller log; current-state claims have solver-visible evidence.

Controller log records west disconnect/reconnect, attempt-suffixed message ids, count-based divergence, duplicate effect on evt-west-g01-005127, checkpoint gaps, and retention candidate_rows against replay pin 5311.

Captured stream/source state shows shared EDGE_TELEMETRY names, west hub source domain edge-east, consumer ack floors ahead of application sequences, and cleanup_safe_sequence equal to archive_sequence.

Solver-visible contract states stable event_id message ids, generation hold on sequence regression, identity reconciliation, poison-not-progress, fence-epoch increment, and min(archive, consumer, replay-pin) retention. Live mixins implement weaker predicates against that contract; that is the work package, not documentation-as-LOC.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Stabilizing Nats-Msg-Id to event_id without moving PUBLISHED until the expected-stream ACK still finalizes the journal on timeout/wrong-stream.
Holding fingerprint changes as pending without treating origin sequence regression as a generation transition still silently rewinds the confirmed watermark.
Committing effects before ACK without a unique (consumer,event_id) effect key still inserts a second CONFIRMED dispatch on redelivery.
Making reconcile counts match without identity set-difference still hides offsetting missing/extra event_ids, which then starves replay of the true holes.
Planning only missing ids while still allowing overlapping non-identical active ranges, or planning against an unapproved generation, still collides recovery work.
Incrementing fence_epoch on expired reacquire without asserting that epoch on execute_replay_plan item mutations still lets a stale owner finish replay.
Pinning cleanup to archive high-water only still deletes rows newer than the slowest required consumer or an approved replay start.
Renaming origin streams without correcting hub source domain/subject_transforms still lets the archive ingest the wrong leaf or local telemetry.raw inserts.
ACKing poison/quarantine as application progress still makes consumer_health and retention believe those origins are complete.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of the load-bearing core (store journal/effects/checkpoints/replay/leases, runtime JetStream admin/publisher/bootstrap/lab manager, model identity/topology/lease types, cli operator commands, live mixin verbs, and policy execute_replay/inspect_health) would collapse publish, archive sync, consumer drain, reconcile, replay, retention, and lab-start. Separately, removing the ~405-line shadowed policy copies, ~38-line dead identity-lag helpers, ~156-line unused store accessors, and unused async_main would not change current starter operator outcomes—evidence of modest padding, not systemic inflation. Seed/sql/seed.sql removal does not change runtime behavior of an already-built DB.
